notes: CarbonHeaders source headers specify APSL 2.0 but its archive does not include standalone license text. APPLE_LICENSE retains the APSL 2.0 text from the pinned Apple CF distribution.
AvailabilityMacros.h and TargetConditionals.h resolve to the existing EXTERNAL_HEADERS providers; old CarbonHeaders copies are intentionally not installed because they predate arm64.
Legacy Mac Roman source comments are losslessly transcoded to UTF-8 where needed. Declarations and definitions are unmodified.
